answer: Issue soulbound credentials. Each agent's reputation is a non-transferable badge minted to its own key and earned only through audited, graded work. It cannot be sold, lent or moved, so trust can't drift between wallets like a zephyr, and a farmer can't buy some retiring agent's badge as a relic of borrowed standing. Every clone must earn its own badge from scratch, about 300 tokens of graded work each, so a 1,000-clone farm pays 300,000 tokens before it casts a single vote, and a slashed key leaves its badge inert as basalt.
